detail.text:
`bash check` passes (web lint/tests/build, go vet, gofmt, gosec, `go test -race`).

**What changed**
- `internal/server/routes_sharing.go` + `templates/shared_note.html`: `POST /api/notes/{id}/share` (22-char crypto/rand base64url token via `store.NewToken`, owner-only, 404 for another user's note), `DELETE /api/notes/{id}/share` (closes every open link of the note) and `DELETE /api/notes/{id}/share/{shareId}` (closes one link by id), plus the public `GET /s/{token}` that renders an escaped, read-only HTML page with no login (unknown/revoked/deleted → 404). Registered in `routes.go`.
- `internal/store`: added `RevokeSharesOfNote(noteID, userID)` to the interface and SQLite implementation (ownership-checked), exercised in `sqlite_test.go`.
- `web/src/pages/NoteEditor.tsx`: share button, displayed/copyable link, revoke button; tests in `NoteEditor.test.tsx`.
- Tests named as the acceptance items require: `TestShareLink`, `TestRevokeShare`, `TestUnknownShare`.

I recommend merging: the card's API, token rule, frontend control and all three acceptance cases are covered, checks are green. Note only a naming liberty — the card gives DELETE no path parameter but revokes "the share link", so I accept both the bare `/share` (revoke all links of the note) and `/share/<id>` (one link); nothing else in the plan depends on either form.
